text.description_html:
TC4361 ADA Compliant Global Heavy Duty Door Closer

The Global TC4361 (old part number TC1461) is a heavy duty closer designed for maximum versatility and fast installation. It is a direct fit replacement for a LCN 1460. It is recommend for use on heavy duty commercial, architectural and institutional applications. Closers with non-hold open arms are UL listed R15416 430U for "A" label fire doors.

The unique hole pattern offers a variety of options and features for both new construction and retrofit / tennant improvement installs. Supplied with a slim cover, standard duty arm and a parallel arm bracket to accomodate all applications. Comes with all fasteners, brackets and soffit plates for versatility. A complete line of Global TC4361 Door Closer Accessories is available.

Global Series TC4361 Door Closers are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and backcheck cushioning. They are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations. They fit 7 1/2" x 1" mounting hole pattern, direct fit replacement for a LCN 1461 (LCN 1460 series).

Features and Specifications of TC4361 Heavy Duty Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 7 1/2"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 1"
  • Maximum Door Size: 60" interior / 48" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 1-6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • Optional Arms: Cushion Arm or Hold Open Arm
  • ADA Compliant
  • UL 10C Compliant
  • Includes Slim Line Cover
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 25 Year Manufacturer's Warranty
  • TC4361 Specifications (PDF)
  • TC4361 Installation (PDF)

The TC4361 is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.

NOTE: the standard arm shown in the upper right product image is included.

However, you can add an optional Heavy Duty Cushion Arm or Hold Open Arm if desired.
